faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Project Assistant posts in NIT Silchar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant post in the NIT Silchar Recruitment 2026. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates to join a prestigious institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Silchar Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Project Assistant post at NIT Silchar is 25 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Silchar Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Assistant posts at NIT Silchar is Email. Interested candidates need to send their complete application and documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant post at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the rules set by the Government of India for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Assistant position at NIT Silchar is Rs. 20,000/- per month, along with HRA. This is a contractual position offering competitive remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc or a Diploma in Engineering and Technology (minimum 3 years duration) to be eligible for the Project Assistant position at NIT Silchar.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NIT Silchar Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Silchar Project Assistant Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant post at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant post at NIT Silchar primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Assistant post is Silchar, Assam, specifically at the National Institute of Technology Silchar. It is located in the pincode 788010.
